editorial:
Imagine being a guy who lives for one thing: chasing women. That is Barry, a total slave to his urges who spends every waking second thinking about sex. Then, life throws him a massive curveball. After a weird accident, he wakes up in a hospital bed to find out his testicles are gone. It sounds like a bad joke, but that is exactly where the story starts. You get to watch Barry go from a shallow player to a man who has to figure out who he actually is when his primary drive is suddenly switched off. It is a wild, awkward, and funny ride that feels like a strange social experiment.

The acting is surprisingly solid and the pacing keeps you moving through the awkwardness. You will love seeing Barry's personality shift as he finds out that being nice actually works better than being a creep. While some of the humor is a bit crude, it hits the mark for a raunchy comedy. It is a great pick if you enjoy comedies that are a bit out there and not afraid to be weird.
endingExplained: By the end, Barry realizes that his obsession with sex was actually keeping him lonely. After losing his drive, he learns how to truly connect with people and finds real love with a woman who likes him for his heart, not his game. He accepts his new life and discovers that happiness comes from emotional bonds rather than just physical urges. He ends up a much better, kinder person than he was at the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raunchy comedies with a heart.
